posts.author: Hyuugis
posts.body:
Hi everyone, I'm a maker from Italy. I mostly work with RPG Maker 2003 but I've also made some short games with MV, but I still prefer 2k3 as tool.
I do most of the stuff on my own, I have low pixel art skills: I can edit pre-made assets but not create them from zero. For my stories, I usually ask for help to develop them.
I'll share some of my works soon.

posts.author: Erif
posts.body:
Welcome welcome!
Glad to have you on board!

posts.author: Litningman06
posts.body: Welcome! I primarily use 2k3 too! It’s nice and simple.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome!
It is always great to get folks joining who already have experience. Especially in the older makers.
You have found a great community. Looking forward to whatever you decide to share and however you decide to participate.
Good luck and remember to enjoy what you do!

posts.author: Hyuugis
posts.body:
All right, thank you all for your welcome messages!
In the next days I'll share my completed projects but unfortunately I have to say that my projects made with 2k3 are only in italian for now, I've started to make games in English just recently. Is there a tool that can translate the dialogues faster?
